The Operational Bridge Between Field Reality & Solar Engineering

We founded SolarSite Texas to solve the single largest operational friction point in distributed solar execution: the costly gap between the physical roof/electrical panel and the engineering plan set.

Why High-Volume Solar EPCs Rely on Us

In solar project management, the site survey is not a routine task—it is the foundation upon which structural calculations, electrical single-line diagrams, utility interconnection requests, and municipal building permits depend.

When a field surveyor misses a panel busbar rating, overlooks a cracked clay tile, or records an ambiguous obstruction offset, the downstream cost is severe: drafting revisions, delayed permits, and expensive installation-day truck rolls.

We established a statewide, coordinated field network governed by strict SOPs, digital pitch verification, and our internal triple-check QA protocol to guarantee that every survey package delivered is immediately CAD-ready.

Our Triple-Check Quality Assurance Protocol

How we eliminate missing photos, unreadable busbars, and drafting surprises before release.

STAGE 01

In-Field Checklist Validation

Field surveyors cannot submit jobs without completing all 36 mandatory photo checkpoints, digital pitch readings, and MSP interior dead-front macros.

STAGE 02

Engineering Desk Audit

Our internal technical review desk verifies photo clarity, validates the 120% busbar math, and checks rafter spans against IRC structural tables.

STAGE 03

One-Touch CAD Packaging

Data is compiled into standardized dimensional reports, labeled photo directories, and SLD parameter sheets ready for direct AutoCAD or HelioScope import.
